summary: On 18 August 2026 Nation.Cymru reported that a Senedd petition, Stop all developments on peatlands across Wales, launched in April 2026 by Friends of the Earth Cymru with community groups, the Wildlife Trust of South and West Wales and the Cambrian Mountains Society, had reached 1,400 of the 10,000 signatures needed for a Senedd debate. The petitioners claimed that about 60 large renewable developments proposed in Wales threaten around 36 percent of the peat resource, naming Waun Hesgog energy park and Lluest y Gwynt wind farm. The figure is the campaigners' own and is unverified.
title: Senedd petition seeks to stop all development on Welsh peatland, claiming renewable schemes threaten 36 percent of peat
